Since 01.11 every closed invoice (isPaid) also carries closedAt (date of the last closing receipt, else the Priority status date) and closingReceipts[] {source: שלנו | Priority, receiptKey, priorityReceiptNumber, date, method, amount (the part of the receipt applied to this invoice), status, isEstimate (true when a Priority receipt covering several invoices was spread oldest due date first)}: our ReceiptAllocations plus Priority receipts from the Payments mirror whose matchedInvoiceNumbers include the invoice, a Priority copy of one of our receipts counted once (the same rule as the promise engine). closedWithoutReceipt = true when the invoice is closed and no receipt covers its amount (credit note or write-off). Since 01.11 (fix) EVERY invoice, open or closed, carries paidAmount = the receipts applied to it (the same receipts-only rule as closingReceipts) and paidReceipts[] (same shape as closingReceipts); the card's שולם column reads paidAmount. paidSeenAmount stays the layer field for money seen and not yet in Priority

schema.title: CustomerNotes
schema.description: Our enrichment on the aging report (plan 04.11, part A). A payment promise is a note of type התחייבות לתשלום. One note belongs to one customer + one due month (dueMonth YYYY-MM). The four active types need actionDate and open a grouped task (CollectionQueue, key notes:<type>:<date>:<bookkeeper>) on the date from AgentSettings noteTask.*; any note may have reminderDate. A note closes automatically only when the month's open balance in OpenMovements reaches 0 (status נסגרה – החודש התאפס, closedAt) and stays as history. outcome / amountReceived / amountRemaining / checkedAt are set for commitments by CheckCommitments the day after actionDate, after the receipts run. legacyId is no longer used (the old tables were removed in wave 3). The customer link is the app's first real reference column; customerCode and customerName stay beside it because agents read them.

Nothing points at a movement row: notes point at customer + dueMonth, so replacing rows is safe. Includes invoices, receipts on account, partial balances and journal entries. amount > 0 = debt, < 0 = credit. dueMonth = YYYY-MM of dueDate. AddCustomerNote.usageDescription:
This action is triggered by:

- **Adding a note on the aging report**: On "דוח גיול", the user clicks the notes chip (or the "+" that appears on hover) under a customer's month, clicks "הערה" in the small notes window, picks the type, fills the date, text, reminder or amount, and clicks "שמירת הערה"
  Saves the note on that customer and month. The window then says which follow-up task will open and when, for example "תיפתח משימה ב-12.11 אם החודש לא יתאפס".
- **Adding a note from a customer card**: On a customer card, the user clicks "הערה" on a month row of "חודשים פתוחים" (or the main button "הוספת הערה", then picks the month), and saves the note the same way
  Saves the note for that month; the card's feed, the "התחייבויות" strip and the months table update.
- **Adding a note from a grouped task**: On "משימות", the user opens a grouped task's rows, clicks a customer and month, and adds a note in the same window
  Saves the note for that customer and month, with the same line about the task it will open.
- **Approving a payment commitment from an email**: In "פניות", the user opens an email where Maya found a payment promise, checks the amount, date and invoices in the "הצעת התחייבות מהמייל" card, and clicks "אשר התחייבות"
  Records one payment commitment for the customer on the due month of the oldest invoice picked, marks Maya's proposal as approved and the email as handled. Approving the same email twice is refused.

AgentCall.actionTypeDescription: Invoke a simple REACT LLM agent ( not attached to any agent in the app ), with the provided action tools and return the response based on structuredOutputJsonSchema

instructions.title: Instructions
instructions.description: Instructions for the agent. If provided, the agent will follow these instructions.

items.description: ActionTool. The action type to be available to the REACT agent as a tool. The REACT agent will be able to use the action tool to perform the action. Without action tools, the REACT agent will not be able to perform any actions. IMPORTANT: when providing tools, make sure to provide all the required context to satisfy the tool inputs as part of the prompt.

actionBlockId.description: The actionTypeId of the action to be used by the REACT agent as a tool.

inputOverrides.description: Optional map of workflow input field names to fixed values. These are merged into the tool call (overriding model-provided values) and removed from the tool argument schema shown to the model.

files.title: Files
files.description: The file URLs to be used as context for the LLM model. Files MUST be provided here to be processed by the model.

structuredOutputJsonSchema.title: Structured Output
structuredOutputJsonSchema.description:
An optional JSON schema for the final agent output. Structured Outputs JSON Schema ensures the model will always generate responses that adhere to your supplied JSON Schema.
        Some type-specific keywords are not supported. Notable keywords not supported include:
        For strings: minLength, maxLength, pattern, format
        For numbers: minimum, maximum, multipleOf
        For objects: patternProperties, unevaluatedProperties, propertyNames, minProperties, maxProperties
        For arrays: unevaluatedItems, contains, minContains, maxContains, minItems, maxItems, uniqueItems

modelName.title: Model
modelName.description: Model family. Always runs the latest model in that family. Leave unset to inherit the agent's own model, including any pinned version.

recursionLimit.title: Recursion Limit
recursionLimit.description: Max reasoning/tool steps before the agent stops (1–1000). Leave empty for the default (300).

streaming.description: Whether to stream the response from the LLM model.

AgentThreadHistory.actionTypeDescription: Reads an agent conversation thread's history (messages and tool calls) from the agent's persistent short-term memory.

threadId.description: The conversation's thread id — the threadId the agent was sent the messages with (e.g. by SendAgentMessage, or the chatThreadId of an agent-chat turn). Variables syntax: {{input.VariableName}}.

toolDetail.description: How much tool activity to include. 'full' = tool calls (name + args) and their results; 'summary' = the tool calls the agent made, without the result payloads; 'none' = only user/assistant text.

count.description: Number of turns to return. A turn is one user message plus the agent's full response to it. Omit to return all turns from the offset.

offset.description: Number of turns to skip from the anchor chosen by order (for paging through a long thread).

order.description: Which end to page from: 'end' (default) anchors at the most recent turn, 'start' at the oldest. Returned messages are always chronological.

found.description: Whether a stored thread was found.

totalTurns.description: Total turns in the thread, before windowing.

turnCount.description: Number of turns in the returned window.

toolCalls.description: Tool calls made by the assistant.

runId.description: The agent run (turn) that produced the message -- the agentRunId the rows it wrote carry. Absent on older messages.

AnalyzePriceGap.usageDescription:
This action is triggered by:

- **Opening a price case**: automatically when a bookkeeper opens a price-difference case page (מסמכים ומחירים → a price case), and again after an approval is marked
  Shows the per-line gap table — charged price against the valid price list, price source, manager approval, the order's free text and the reason per line — without changing anything.
- **Opening a price-difference mail**: automatically when a bookkeeper opens a mail of type "הפרש מחיר" on the Inbox page (פניות → דואר נכנס) and a price case was opened from it
  Shows the same per-line gap table in the left side of the mail panel, without changing anything.

AnnotatePdfFormFields.actionTypeDescription: Adds fillable form fields to a PDF at specified positions. Supports text, checkbox (14x14), dropdown, optionList (multi-select), radio (14x14 per option with labels), signature (200x50; defaultValue may be PNG/JPEG base64 drawn as an image), and date (100x20, 10-char max for YYYY-MM-DD) fields. Each field type has appropriate default dimensions. Coordinates are in points (1/72 inch) from the bottom-left corner of each page.

pdfUrl.description: URL to the PDF file. Can be a protected internal URL (ending with /redirect) or a public URL.

fields.description: List of form fields to add to the PDF

name.description: Unique name/identifier for the form field

type.description: Type of form field. Default sizes per type: text (200x20), checkbox (14x14), dropdown (200x24), optionList (200x80), radio (14x14 per option with labels), signature (200x50), date (100x20 with 10-char max)

page.description: Page number (0-indexed) where the field should be placed

x.description: X coordinate (from left edge of page) in points

y.description: Y coordinate (from bottom edge of page) in points

width.description: Width of the field in points. Optional - defaults based on field type (e.g., 14 for checkbox, 200 for text)

height.description: Height of the field in points. Optional - defaults based on field type (e.g., 14 for checkbox, 20 for text)

defaultValue.description: Default value for the field. For type signature: PNG or JPEG as raw base64 or data URL (data:image/png;base64,... or data:image/jpeg;base64,...); embedded as a bitmap on the page.

options.description: Options for dropdown or radio fields

readOnly.description: Whether the field is read-only. When true, the widget is drawn with no border (border width 0).

multiline.description: For text fields: enables multiple lines. For optionList: enables multi-select

- **Approving an allocation**: Clicking "אשר פיזור" in the allocation editor on the Receipts screen

ConfirmSender.usageDescription:
This action is triggered by:

- **Confirming an unknown sender**: Clicking "אשר ושמור איש קשר" on the "זה הלקוח X?" card in the email panel of the inbox (פניות)
  Saves the sender as a contact of the suggested customer, marks the email as verified, opens a task to add the contact in Priority and prepares the reply draft.
- **Choosing another customer**: Clicking "בחר לקוח אחר", picking the customer and confirming on the same card
  Saves the sender as a contact of the chosen customer instead.
- **Rejecting the sender**: Clicking "השולח לא שייך ללקוח", writing a short note and saving
  Records that the sender is not a customer contact and closes the verification task; nothing else changes.

CustomerSummaryRun.usageDescription:
This action is triggered by:

- **Every morning, automatically**: The morning run asks Iris to write a short summary for every customer with an open balance, an open task or a promise
  Each customer card then opens on Iris's summary of the account, with one suggested next step and the facts it is based on.
- **Refreshing one customer's summary**: On a customer card ("כרטיס לקוח"), the user clicks "רענן סיכום" in Iris's summary at the top of the card (also offered when there is no summary yet)
  Iris rewrites the summary for that customer only, from the latest invoices, notes, promises and emails, and the card shows the new text as soon as it is saved. Nothing is sent to the customer.

DataImport.actionTypeDescription: Import CSV or Excel files into data tables. This action loads files from URLs (public or protected), applies transformations (column mapping, joins, filters, aggregations), and imports the results into target tables. Supports multiple sources and targets in a single operation. Targets are processed sequentially - each completed target becomes available for subsequent targets to reference via JOINs, enabling you to use inserted IDs as foreign keys (e.g., import categories first, then import tasks that reference the category IDs). Use this action to bulk import data, combine data from multiple files, handle relational data with foreign keys, or transform data during import.

sources.description: Array of source files to load. Each source must have a unique name that can be referenced in target queries. Sources are loaded first and remain available for all targets. Example: [{"name": "customers", "url": "https://example.com/data.csv", "type": "csv"}]

targets.description: Array of target table specifications. Each target defines how to transform and where to store the data. Targets are processed in order - previously processed targets become available as tables for subsequent targets to join/reference. This allows you to use the inserted IDs from earlier targets (like categories) as foreign keys in later targets (like tasks). Example: First target creates "categories", second target can JOIN to "categories" to get category IDs.

Use expressions for calculated conditions like "revenue / cost > 1.5" or "score >= threshold". IMPORTANT LIMITATION: You CANNOT filter aggregations based on OTHER aggregated values when the filter needs to compare row-level data to group-level aggregates. Example of UNSUPPORTED pattern: Define "avgAge = AVG(age)" then filter "COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE age > avgAge)" - this requires comparing each row's age to the group average, which is not supported. WORKAROUND: Use window functions instead - they make aggregated values available at the row level before final aggregation.

expression.description:
SQL expression for calculated columns in the query result.
*** MULTI-LAYER CALCULATIONS: You CAN reference previously defined aliases (including aggregations) in new expressions. The system automatically creates multi-layer CTEs to resolve dependencies. This means you can build complex calculations in stages, like avgSales = AVG(sales), then totalWithBonus = avgSales * 1.1, then ratio = totalWithBonus / SUM(costs). However, you CANNOT use aggregated values in FILTERS of other aggregations when comparing to row-level data (use window functions for that pattern). ***

Supports:
- Arithmetic: revenue / cost, (A + B) * C, salary - 1000, value * 2
- Aggregations: SUM(sales), AVG(sales), COUNT(orders), MIN(price), MAX(price)
- Date/Time: EXTRACT(YEAR|MONTH|DAY|HOUR|MINUTE|SECOND|QUARTER|WEEK|DOW|DOY|EPOCH FROM date), DATE_TRUNC('day'|'month'|'year', timestamp), DATE_PART('hour', time), AGE(birthDate), NOW(), CURRENT_DATE, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
- String Functions: UPPER(name), LOWER(name), LENGTH(name), SUBSTRING(name, 1, 5), CONCAT(firstName, ' ', lastName)
- Math Functions: ABS(value), CEIL(value), CEILING(value), FLOOR(value), ROUND(value, 2), TRUNC(value)
- Utility Functions: COALESCE(value, defaultValue), NULLIF(value, nullValue), GREATEST(val1, val2, ...), LEAST(val1, val2, ...)
- Conditional Logic: CASE WHEN age > 18 THEN 'adult' WHEN age > 65 THEN 'senior' ELSE 'minor' END
- Type Casting: value::text, value::integer, value::numeric, value::boolean, dateStr::timestamp, value::date
- NULL Tests: column IS NULL, column IS NOT NULL
- Comparisons: =, <>, <, >, <=, >= (use in CASE statements)
- Alias References & Chaining Examples: completionRate = completedTasks / totalTasks, adjustedRate = completionRate * 100, remaining = (1 - completionRate) * 100
All values are safely parameterized to prevent SQL injection.

DecideApproval.usageDescription:
This action is triggered by:

- **Approving a draft from a mail**: "אישור" on a draft in the mail panel on the Inbox page (פניות → דואר נכנס, click a mail)
  Marks the draft "אושר – לא נשלח". If the bookkeeper changed the subject or body first, the change is saved just before. Nothing is sent.
- **Editing a draft**: "שמירת העריכה" on a draft in the mail panel or in the outbox draft panel, after changing its subject or body
  Saves the bookkeeper's wording on the pending draft.
- **Rejecting a draft**: "דחייה" on a draft (with an optional reason), in the mail panel or the outbox draft panel
  Marks the draft as rejected.
- **Approving or rejecting drafts in bulk**: tick drafts in the outbox list (פניות → דואר יוצא), then "אישור" or "דחייה" in the bar above the list
  Decides all the ticked pending drafts at once. Nothing is sent.
- **Approving a whole monthly batch**: "אישור כל המנה" in the outbox when it is filtered to one batch (from "כל המנה" on a row, or from the automation's run), after confirming
  Marks every pending draft of that batch "אושר – לא נשלח". Nothing is sent.
- **Approving one draft from the outbox**: click a row in the outbox, then "אישור" in the draft panel
  Same as approving from the mail panel.
- **Approving the open-debts batch**: "אישור המנה" on the Open-debts batch (מנת חובות פתוחים) screen, after confirming
  Moves every pending draft of the current month's batch to "אושר – לא נשלח" (under "שלי", only the drafts in view).
- **Rejecting one batch draft**: "דחה" on a row of the batch table
  Takes that customer's draft out of the batch.
- **Approving a case draft**: "אשר" on a draft in the "הטיוטות של מאיה" section of a documents or price case page (מסמכים ומחירים → a case) — the logistics request or reminder, the customer package, or the price approval request
  Marks the draft "אושר – לא נשלח". Nothing is sent; approving the customer package marks the email as answered.
- **Rejecting a case draft**: "דחה" on the same draft (with an optional reason)
  Marks the draft as rejected; the case stays open.
- **Approving a detail request from the receipts screen**: "אישור הטיוטה" in the "טיפול ברשומה" panel on the receipts screen (תקבולים), opened with "פתיחת טיוטת מייל ללקוח" in Nina's recommendation or "טיפול ברשומה" in the file summary
  Marks Nina's request for payment details to the customer's bookkeeping as "אושר – לא נשלח". If the wording was changed, the change is saved first. Nothing is sent — the send button is shown but not active yet.
- **Editing a detail request**: "שמירת שינויים" in the same panel, after changing the subject or body
  Saves the bookkeeper's wording on the pending draft; it is the same draft the approvals screen (אישורים) shows.

decidedBy.description: Display name of the person approving

DecideInsuranceRequest.usageDescription:
This action is triggered by:

- **Approving an increase proposal**: "אישור" on the increase proposal shown in the customer card's "אובליגו וביטוח" tab, while its status is "הוצעה"
  Marks the proposal "אושר – לא הוגש" and records who approved it and when. Nothing is submitted to the insurer; submission opens once the insurer's API keys arrive. If the proposal was already decided, the screen shows why the approval was refused.

decision.description: priorityDone = the receipt was issued in Priority

proposalIds.description: MatchProposals row ids, when the caller has the proposal rather than the receipt

decidedBy.description: Display name of the person deciding

asOfDate.description: Clock for the demo: YYYY-MM-DD. Defaults to today in Asia/Jerusalem

dryRun.description: When true, only report what would be written; nothing changes

decidedByEmail.description: Email of the person deciding (AgentFeedback.byEmail on a correction)

priorityReceiptNumber.description: priorityDone: the receipt number Priority gave

receiptId.description: Receipts row id (preferred; agent cheques have no proposal)

results.description: Per receipt: previous / new receiptStatus, bank line and proposal updates

writeVerified.description: True only when every written row was read back and matches

receipt.description: {receiptKey, receiptId, bankLineId, customerCode, customerName, amount, receiptStatus, matchStatus, priorityReceiptNumber, issuedBy, issuedAt}; null when refused

DecideMatchProposal.usageDescription:
This action is triggered by:

- **Marking a receipt issued in Priority**: In step 2 "קבלה" of the receipt record on the "תקבולים" screen (or from a receipts task), for a bank receipt or an agent cheque, after the bookkeeper copied the instruction and issued the receipt in Priority, typing Priority's receipt number and clicking "הונפקה ב-Priority"
  Marks the receipt "הונפקה ב-Priority" with that number, together with its allocation lines and, for a bank receipt, its bank line. Shown for every approved receipt — bank receipt or agent cheque — that was not issued yet; hidden for drafts and for receipts already issued. Nothing is written to Priority.

DeepResearch.actionTypeDescription: Conducts extensive multi-source research on complex topics, taking 2-5 minutes and is expensive. Use this for questions requiring thorough investigation across multiple perspectives, such as market analysis, competitive research.

describe_data_assets.actionTypeDescription: Columns, warehouse types, what each column means where it was described, what can be measured on a saved query's table (its semantic model: entities, dimensions and metrics), and a few sample rows for tables named as list_data_assets gives them. Read the types before casting: every value query_table returns is a string.

description.description: What the table holds, where it was described.

semantic.description: A saved query's semantic model, where its dbt properties file defines one: `aggTimeDimension` (the time dimension its metrics are counted by), `primaryEntity?`, `entities` (`{ name, type, column?, expr? }` — the keys it joins on; the same entity name on two tables is the join; `expr` when computed rather than a column), `dimensions` (`{ name, type, column?, expr?, granularity? }` — what its numbers are grouped and filtered by) and `metrics` (`{ name, type, label?, description?, agg?, expr?, filter?, aggTimeDimension?, numerator?, denominator?, inputMetrics?, inputMetric?, window?, grainToDate? }` — a `simple` metric is a measure: `agg` over `expr`, its SQL over the table's columns, counting only the rows its `filter` keeps; a `ratio` divides `numerator` by `denominator`, a `derived` one's `expr` combines its `inputMetrics`, a `cumulative` one accumulates `inputMetric` over a trailing `window` or to `grainToDate`. Reproduce a metric from these rather than guessing it) and `view?` — the app's Snowflake semantic view covering the table: when present, read a metric through it rather than re-deriving it, with `SELECT * FROM SEMANTIC_VIEW(<view> DIMENSIONS <model>.<dimension> METRICS <model>.<metric>)` in query_table (a ratio or derived metric is named without `<model>.`).

columns.description: `{ name, type, description? }` per column — `description` is what the column means, where it was described. `_AIRBYTE_*` bookkeeping columns are left out.

error.description: Why this one table could not be described.

EnrichLead.actionTypeDescription: Enriches a lead by conducting a three-step process: 1) WebSearch to find LinkedIn URL using any combination of name, email, company name, or provided linkedInUrl, 2) PerplexitySearch to generate professional insights and summary, 3) LinkedInProfile to fetch complete profile data and LinkedInProfilePicture for profile image. Returns comprehensive CV-like formatted output with all professional information. All inputs are optional - provide whatever information is available.

fullName.description: The full name of the lead to enrich (optional)

email.description: The email address of the lead (optional)

companyName.description: Optional company name to help find the correct LinkedIn profile

linkedInUrl.description: Optional LinkedIn profile URL. If provided, WebSearch step will be skipped.

input.instructions:
1. Search for the person's LinkedIn profile using their name and email
2. Extract the LinkedIn URL from search results
3. Generate a professional summary from the search insights
4. Fetch complete LinkedIn profile data
5. Get the profile picture
6. Update the lead record with all enriched information
7. Handle errors gracefully and update status accordingly
input.prompt:
You are a lead enrichment specialist. Your goal is to conduct a detailed enrichment process and return a comprehensive CV-like profile with all available information.

**Available Information:**
- Full Name: {{input.fullName}}
- Email: {{input.email}}
- Company Name: {{input.companyName}}
- LinkedIn URL: {{input.linkedInUrl}}

**STEP 1: Find LinkedIn URL (if not provided)**
{{#if input.linkedInUrl}}
LinkedIn URL provided: {{input.linkedInUrl}}
{{else}}
Use WebSearch to find their LinkedIn profile URL. Build a search query using whatever information is available:
- If you have name, email, and company: Search for '{{input.fullName}} {{input.companyName}} {{input.email}} LinkedIn profile'
- If you have name and email: Search for '{{input.fullName}} {{input.email}} LinkedIn profile'
- If you have name and company: Search for '{{input.fullName}} {{input.companyName}} LinkedIn profile'
- If you have email only: Search for '{{input.email}} LinkedIn profile'
- If you have company only: Search for '{{input.companyName}} LinkedIn employees'
- Use any combination of available fields to find the LinkedIn profile URL

Extract the LinkedIn profile URL from the search results. Look for URLs that match the pattern linkedin.com/in/[username].
{{/if}}

**STEP 2: Fetch Complete LinkedIn Data**
Use LinkedInProfile with the URL to fetch their complete professional data including experience, education, skills, headline, summary, and location.

**STEP 3: Get Profile Picture**
Use LinkedInProfilePicture with the same LinkedIn URL to get their profile image URL.

**STEP 4: Generate Professional Summary using PerplexitySearch**
Use PerplexitySearch to generate a comprehensive professional summary and insights. Build your search query using all available information:
- Use name, company, LinkedIn data, and any other details to search for professional background, career achievements, and expertise
- Example: '{{input.fullName}} {{#if input.companyName}}{{input.companyName}} {{/if}} professional background career achievements expertise'

**STEP 5: Return Complete CV-Like Profile**
Return ALL the enriched lead information in a comprehensive CV format including:
- Full name (from input or LinkedIn)
- Email (from input)
- LinkedIn URL
- Profile picture URL
- Professional headline
- Location
- AI-generated summary with insights
- Complete work experience with all details
- Education history
- Skills list
- Any additional professional information found

Make sure to populate ALL fields in the structured output with the enriched data.

For context:
fullName: {{input.fullName}}
email: {{input.email}}
companyName: {{input.companyName}}
linkedInUrl: {{input.linkedInUrl}}

GetCreditExposure.usageDescription:
This action is triggered by:

- **Opening the "אובליגו" tab on a customer card**: Clicking the tab (shown for every customer), the "אובליגו וביטוח" link in the card's credit insurance box (insured customers), or arriving from an alert on the היום screen
  Shows a one-sentence summary, the insurance cover (insurer, cover number, insured amount, validity, status, last sync) or, for a customer without credit insurance, the credit limit from Priority, static and dynamic obligo against the insured amount or that credit limit, the transfers and receipts that lower the dynamic obligo (each transfer links to its record on the receipts screen), cheques expected to drop on deposit, and the obligo breakdown by document type. Nothing is changed, sent or written to Priority.
- **Opening the היום screen**: Runs on load for the credit insurance card (limited to the selected bookkeeper's customers when the screen is filtered)
  Lists the customers whose dynamic obligo reached the threshold of the insured amount and the covers about to expire, each linking straight to the customer's "אובליגו" tab. Runs again after "יצירת הצעות" creates increase proposals from that card.

invoices.description: Every invoice with the live layer: paymentState, paidSeenAmount, effectiveOpenAmount, remainingAmount (= effectiveOpenAmount), paymentStatus (פתוחה / שולמה חלקית / שולמה), receiptKeys, isPaid, latestNote*, notesCount, delivery-note scan counts, and receipts[] {receiptKey, amount (allocated to this invoice), valueDate, receiptStatus, matchStatus, priorityReceiptNumber, kind, source}, newest first. Since 01.11 every closed invoice (isPaid) also carries closedAt (date of the last closing receipt, else the Priority status date) and closingReceipts[] {source: שלנו | Priority, receiptKey, priorityReceiptNumber, date, method, amount (the part of the receipt applied to this invoice), status, isEstimate (true when a Priority receipt covering several invoices was spread oldest due date first)}: our ReceiptAllocations plus Priority receipts from the Payments mirror whose matchedInvoiceNumbers include the invoice, a Priority copy of one of our receipts counted once (the same rule as the promise engine). closedWithoutReceipt = true when the invoice is closed and no receipt covers its amount (credit note or write-off). Since 01.11 (fix) EVERY invoice, open or closed, carries paidAmount = the receipts applied to it (the same receipts-only rule as closingReceipts) and paidReceipts[] (same shape as closingReceipts); the card's שולם column reads paidAmount. paidSeenAmount stays the layer field for money seen and not yet in Priority

paymentState.title: paymentState
paymentState.description: App layer (never written by the Priority sync): payment we have seen. נראה תשלום = an approved receipt match pays this invoice and the receipt is not yet in Priority; נקלט ב-Priority = the match was marked done in Priority. Empty = no payment seen by the app. Recomputed by the shared invoice-layer code

paidSeenAmount.title: paidSeenAmount
paidSeenAmount.description: App layer: ILS of this invoice paid by approved receipt matches (sum of their allocations)

paidSeenAt.title: paidSeenAt
paidSeenAt.description: App layer: when the latest approved match on this invoice was approved. ISO 8601 datetime string, format: YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS, e.g. 2025-09-30T18:45:00Z, 2025-09-30T18:45:00+05:30

paidSeenBankLineIds.title: paidSeenBankLineIds
paidSeenBankLineIds.description: App layer: comma-separated bank line ids of the approved matches

paidPriorityDoneAt.title: paidPriorityDoneAt
paidPriorityDoneAt.description: App layer: when the receipt was marked done in Priority (latest of the matches). ISO 8601 datetime string, format: YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS, e.g. 2025-09-30T18:45:00Z, 2025-09-30T18:45:00+05:30

layerUpdatedAt.title: layerUpdatedAt
layerUpdatedAt.description: App layer: when the payment and note fields above were last recomputed. ISO 8601 datetime string, format: YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS, e.g. 2025-09-30T18:45:00Z, 2025-09-30T18:45:00+05:30

paymentStatus.title: paymentStatus
paymentStatus.description: App layer (never written by the Priority sync): payment status from our receipt allocations. פתוחה = nothing allocated; שולמה חלקית = allocated less than Priority's open amount; שולמה = fully allocated. Priority's own status stays in status.

remainingAmount.title: remainingAmount
remainingAmount.description: App layer: what is still open after our receipt allocations = openAmount − paidSeenAmount while Priority has not reflected them, else openAmount. The aging report and the customer card show this

receiptKeys.title: receiptKeys
receiptKeys.description: App layer: comma-separated Receipts.receiptKey of the receipts allocated to this invoice

subStatus.title: subStatus
subStatus.description: Our layer: the one sub-status shown, by precedence בבירור > שולמה חלקית > פתוחה; סגורה when nothing is left open (הובטחה is no longer set: commitments are CustomerNotes per customer + due month)

openDisputeId.title: openDisputeId
openDisputeId.description: Our layer: the open dispute on the invoice (text link to Disputes.id)

priorityKey.title: priorityKey
priorityKey.description: Sync: Priority natural key (<priorityForm>:<IVNUM>, e.g. CINVOICES:MF26001079). Written only by SyncFromBrain.

sourceUpdatedAt.title: sourceUpdatedAt
sourceUpdatedAt.description: Sync: last change time in Priority when the source reports one, else null.. ISO 8601 datetime string, format: YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS, e.g. 2025-09-30T18:45:00Z, 2025-09-30T18:45:00+05:30

syncRunId.title: syncRunId
syncRunId.description: Sync: SyncRuns.runId of the run that last wrote this row.

lastAppWriteAt.title: lastAppWriteAt
lastAppWriteAt.description: Sync: when the app last wrote this row to Priority (write-through). A sync whose Brain data is older skips the row.. ISO 8601 datetime string, format: YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS, e.g. 2025-09-30T18:45:00Z, 2025-09-30T18:45:00+05:30

pendingBrainConfirm.title: pendingBrainConfirm
pendingBrainConfirm.description: Sync: true after an app write-through until a Brain sync newer than lastAppWriteAt confirms it.

deletedInSource.title: deletedInSource
deletedInSource.description: Sync: true when a fully-read Brain table no longer contains this key. Row and enrichment are kept.

priorityForm.title: priorityForm
priorityForm.description: Mirror: the Priority form the document comes from

currencyCode.title: currencyCode

GetWeekBrief.usageDescription:
This action is triggered by:

- **Opening the home screen**: The "היום" screen of the collections workspace runs it once as soon as it opens (the last result for the same view shows instantly while the fresh one loads), again when the user switches the top-bar filter between "שלי" and "של כולם", and when the user clicks "רענון" at the top of the screen
  Fills the whole screen: on the right the week at a glance ("השבוע במבט אחד") for this calendar week from the aging report (the headline, the short list of conclusions, the four totals, the week board by day with every invoice due, promise, claimed payment and query, and the customers overdue with no note), and on the left Nina's short summary of today's bank transfers (how many were pulled, how many are already matched and how many are left to match).

IdentifyCustomers.usageDescription:
This action is triggered by:

- **Identifying a waiting line**: Clicking "זהה" on a line marked "ממתינה לזיהוי" in the customer identification list on the "תקבולים" screen, or in step 1 "זיהוי" of the receipt record that opens from that line
  Finds the customer of that one bank line and gives it a confidence score, so the line can be approved and its receipt issued. Nothing is sent.
- **Re-identifying today's lines**: Clicking "זהה מחדש" at the top of the customer identification list on the "תקבולים" screen
  Runs the customer identification again on every line of today that is not approved yet, gives each line a customer with a confidence score, and shows one line with how many came out certain, uncertain or unknown. Approved receipts are never touched, and nothing is sent.

IssueReceipt.usageDescription:
This action is triggered by:

- **Approving all certain lines**: Clicking "אשר את כל הוודאיים" at the top of the customer identification list on the "תקבולים" screen, then confirming in the dialog that shows how many receipts and the total
  Approves the identified customer of every certain line on the screen and issues their receipts: each receipt is approved, its PDF is made, and a mail draft to the customer's accounts-payable contact waits in the outbox for a person to approve. A customer with no such contact gets a "חסר איש קשר הנהלת חשבונות" task instead. Lines that are no longer certain or were already approved are listed with the reason.
- **Approving one line**: Clicking "אשר לקוח והוצא קבלה" (after picking or confirming the customer) or the small "אשר" on a line of the list, or "אשר והוצא קבלה" / "אשר לקוח והוצא קבלה" in step 1 "זיהוי" of the receipt record (opened from the list or from a receipts task)
  Does the same for that one line with the customer the person chose, and remembers the payer's name for that customer.
- **Preparing a receipt's mail again**: Clicking "הכנה שוב" on an approved line whose mail was not prepared
  Retries only the PDF and the mail draft; it never creates a second receipt or a second draft.

This action is triggered by:

- **Recording the agent's approval**: "סימון: סוכן אישר" on a price case page, then "סימון סוכן אישר" in the evidence window after pasting the approval email or a link (or picking one of the customer's emails)
  Saves who marked it, when, and the evidence, and moves the case to waiting for the manager.
- **Recording the manager's approval**: "סימון: מנהל אישר" on the same page, then confirming in the evidence window
  Saves the mark and moves the case to "ממתינה לזיכוי" with the summary for the credit note. Marking before the agent's approval, or without evidence, is refused and the reason is shown.
- **Recording an approval from the mail**: the same "סימון: סוכן אישר" / "סימון: מנהל אישר" buttons in the price section of the mail panel on the Inbox page (פניות → דואר נכנס)
  Works exactly as on the case page.

MergeImageLayers.actionTypeDescription: Merge an arbitrary set of image layers into one flattened PNG. Each layer carries a fileUrl (a protected /redirect URL or a public image URL) and a zIndex (lower = bottom), plus optional x/y offset, width/height resize with a fit mode, and opacity. The canvas uses the given width/height, or auto-sizes to the bounding box of all layers. Layers fully outside the canvas are skipped; overflow is clipped. Stores the result as an image file block and returns its block id and protected URL.

layers.description: Image layers to merge. Composited bottom→top by zIndex (ties keep array order).

fileUrl.description: Image for this layer: a protected internal file URL (ending with /redirect) or a public image URL.

zIndex.description: Stacking order. Lower is composited first (bottom); higher sits on top.

x.description: Left offset in px from the canvas origin (def 0).

y.description: Top offset in px from the canvas origin (def 0).

width.description: Resize width in px. Omit to keep native width.

height.description: Resize height in px. Omit to keep native height.

fit.description: How the layer fits when both width and height are given. Default "fill".

width.description: Output canvas width in px. If omitted, auto-sizes to the bounding box of all layers.

height.description: Output canvas height in px. If omitted, auto-sizes to the bounding box of all layers.

backgroundColor.description: CSS color behind all layers (e.g. "#ffffff"). Default transparent.

outputFileName.description: Optional output file name (defaults to a generated .png name).

fileSize.description: Size in bytes.

PrepareVoiceAssistant.actionTypeDescription: Returns voice assistant configuration for incoming call prep workflows. Use as the workflow output action after building dynamic instructions. Does not place a call — the Incoming Voice Call trigger uses this output to answer inbound calls.

instructions.title: Assistant instructions
instructions.description: Define voice agent's personality, role, and how they should behave on the call

firstMessage.description: First message the assistant will say when the call is answered

language.title: Call language
language.description: Set this to match the language the user asked for. If the request, the instructions, or the firstMessage are written in a given language (e.g. Hebrew → "he", Spanish → "es", French → "fr"), you MUST set this field to that language code — do not leave it on the default "en" just because the language setting wasn't mentioned explicitly. Spoken language of the call. This single field automatically configures the best transcriber (speech-to-text), voice model (text-to-speech) and assistant conversation language — no other language setup is needed or possible. "en" (default) keeps the standard English setup: Deepgram transcription with the selected ElevenLabs voice. Hebrew uses Deepgram transcription and the selected native Hebrew Cartesia voice (see voiceId for the Hebrew voice catalog). Every other language pins a multilingual ElevenLabs transcriber to that exact language (never auto-detected); it then uses the selected ElevenLabs voice where supported, or a native Azure neural voice for languages ElevenLabs cannot speak (ca, et, lt, lv, th). For Hebrew the stability/similarityBoost/speed voice settings are ignored; for Azure-voiced languages the selected voiceId and the stability/similarityBoost settings are ignored. The assistant is always instructed to converse in the selected language. Always write instructions, firstMessage and endCallMessage in the selected language. Unsupported codes fall back to "en".

voiceId.description: Voice for the call. It MUST match the selected language, and its gender should match the requested caller persona (or the linked agent's gender) — the two catalogs below are NOT interchangeable, and a voice ID from the wrong catalog is replaced with that language's default voice at call time. Spoken language of the call. This single field automatically configures the best transcriber (speech-to-text), voice model (text-to-speech) and assistant conversation language — no other language setup is needed or possible. ProcessInboundEmail.actionTypeDescription: Provider-independent handling of one normalised inbound email (component 04), called by each mailbox adapter workflow (none connected now — the Gmail adapter was removed 10.11; one Outlook adapter per mailbox later, no logic change). IngestEmail (dedupe, mailbox, threading, customer candidates, hard sender verification, 24h deadline, InboundEmails row). A thread reply goes to AttachThreadReply and opens no new inquiry. A new email: FetchEmailAttachments (code extracts the files and builds the brief) → Maya (CollectionsInboxAgent) sorts it in one structured call with a quote per item, no tools → ApplyMailClassification checks the quotes and the customer and routes by code (PDF, drafts, cases, tasks, aging notes, handling state). A promise is only a proposal for a person to approve in the email panel; a dispute opens a בבירור – מחלוקת aging note per quoted invoice. Nothing is sent: drafts land in the outbox (Approvals).

ProposeAllocation.usageDescription:
This action is triggered by:

- **Opening the allocation editor**: Clicking "פיזור לחשבוניות" (or "עריכת הפיזור") on an approved receipt on the "תקבולים" screen — in the identification list, in the field agents' cheques section, or in step 4 "פיזור" of the receipt record (also opened from a receipts task)
  Loads the customer's open invoices grouped by due month, highlights the months the debt check closed, and pre-fills the suggested amount for each invoice (or the receipt's current allocation). It only reads; nothing is saved.

proposedBy.description: Who asked for the check (the signed-in person's display name)

customers.description: Every insured customer checked: code, name, insured limit, obligo, use %, outcome (הוצעה, מתחת לסף, יש בקשה פתוחה, אין מסגרת מבוטחת)

proposals.description: The CreditLimitRequests rows (written, or that would be written on dryRun)

ProposeInsuranceRequests.usageDescription:
This action is triggered by:

- **Checking customers over the threshold**: "בדיקת לקוחות מעל הסף" on the credit insurance card of the "היום" screen
  First runs as a preview: a small window lists every insured customer whose dynamic obligo reached the threshold of the insured amount and who has no open request, with the insured limit, the use percentage and the requested amount (or says there are none). Nothing is saved yet.
- **Creating the proposals**: "יצירת הצעות" in that window
  Saves one increase proposal per listed customer, recording the signed-in person as the one who asked, and refreshes the insurance card. Each proposal then waits for approval in the customer's "אובליגו וביטוח" tab. Nothing is sent to the insurer or written to Priority.

rechecked.description: Existing agent receipts whose missing debt check ran now

summary.description: One Hebrew sentence for a toast

PullAgentReceipts.usageDescription:
This action is triggered by:

- **Pulling field agents' cheques**: Clicking "משוך צ׳קים של סוכנים" in the "צ׳קים של סוכנים" section of the Receipts screen
  Brings in the cheques the sales agents collected in the last 14 days as receipts, runs the debt check on each, and closes matching "cheque with agent" notes. A one-line summary appears when it finishes, and any problems are listed in the section. It also runs on its own every morning at 09:00.

dryRun.description: Default true: only report what would be written

dryRun.description: Default true: only report what would be written

importBatchId.description: ImportBatches row of the morning run (optional)

dryRun.description: Default true: only report what would be written

query_table.actionTypeDescription: Query this account's synced tables: run one read-only SQL query naming tables by their real names from list_data_assets (`RAW.HUBSPOT_1_CONTACTS`). For file folders use list_files and get_file.

sql.title: Query
sql.description: A single SELECT naming tables by their real names, as list_data_assets gives them — `SELECT count(*) FROM RAW.HUBSPOT_1_CONTACTS`. Synced tables are in `RAW`, saved queries in `MODELED`; describe_data_assets gives a table's columns. Joins and aggregates are allowed; writes are not. Columns named `_AIRBYTE_*` are the replication engine's own bookkeeping and are never returned. File folders are not tables — list them with list_files and read a file with get_file.

limit.title: Row limit
limit.description: Maximum rows to return (default 100, max 1000).

rows.description: Query results, every value as a string.

columns.description: Every column in the result. The replication engine's own `_AIRBYTE_*` columns are excluded, so this is the table as the customer's system has it.

schema.description: `{ name, type }` per column, as the warehouse holds it. Read it before casting: a timestamp column comes back as text in `rows`.

error.title: Why the read did not run
error.description: Set when the read was refused or failed. Read it and correct the request rather than retrying it unchanged.

QueryDatabase.actionTypeDescription: Executes a SQL query against the app's connected PostgreSQL, MySQL, or SQL Server database using `?`-placeholder parameter binding. The engine + connection string are read from the "database" integration connection — pass `connectionId` to use a non-default connection.

connectionId.description: Optional connection-id override. If omitted, the app-level "database" connection is used. The dbType + connection string live on the connection record managed by the identity service.

query.description: SQL statement to execute. Use `?` placeholders for bound parameters — do NOT interpolate user input into the string.

params.description: Values bound positionally to the `?` placeholders in `query`.

maxRows.description: Maximum rows returned to the caller (max 100000). Excess rows are dropped and `truncated` is set to true.

rows.description: Rows returned by the query. Empty array for non-SELECT statements.

rowCount.description: Number of rows affected (INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE) or rows returned for SELECT.

truncated.description: True when the result set exceeded `maxRows` and was truncated.

durationMs.description: Time taken to execute the query in milliseconds.

ReadBankFile.actionTypeDescription: Reads an uploaded bank file on the receipts screen: CreateImportBatch (batch בקריאה), then the nameless reader agent BankFileReader reads the attached file (PDF, Excel, CSV or image) into structured lines, then WriteExtractedLines checks totals, required fields and duplicates and writes BankLines (חדשה / ממתינה לבדיקה) and the batch (נקרא – לאימות or נכשל). Returns the batch; the screen then reads ImportBatches and BankLines. Nothing is matched yet and nothing is written to Priority.

fileText.description: For spreadsheets (CSV/Excel): the sheet rendered as text by the browser, so the reader sees every cell. Empty for PDF and images.

ReadBankFile.usageDescription:
This action is triggered by:

- **Uploading today's bank file**: Clicking "בחירת קובץ" (or dropping a file) in the upload card on the "תקבולים" screen, when the bank lines source in the settings is "קובץ"
  Uploads the bank statement (PDF, Excel, CSV or an image) and has the reader take the transfers out of it into lines for the person to check. It takes a minute or two.
- **Reading a file again**: Clicking "קרא שוב" when reading a file failed or got stuck
  Sends the same file to the reader again.

ReadInvoiceLinesLive.usageDescription:
This action is triggered by:

- **Anyone opening an invoice**: Opening the invoice pop-up from any invoice number
  Reads the invoice's current lines straight from Priority so the lines shown are up to date; if Priority can't be reached, the last saved copy is shown.
- **Collections team, price dispute case page**: Opening a price dispute
  Reads the disputed invoice's lines live from Priority and shows them on the case.

This action is triggered by:

- **Correcting an extracted line**: Clicking "תיקון" on a line of today's bank file on the "תקבולים" screen
  Opens a short form (which field, the right value) that records the reader's mistake and corrects the line, recalculating the file's totals.
- **Clicking "נינה צדקה" or "נינה טעתה" under a checked record**: With an optional note
  Records whether Nina's identification and matching were right, to measure her accuracy. Nina does not reply.

RenderTemplate.actionTypeDescription:
Renders a Handlebars template by filling in placeholders with provided data. Good for generating HTML pages, emails, or formatted text with dynamic content. 
Important: Handlebars syntax is allowed ONLY inside the "template" field passed to this tool. 
You must NOT use Handlebars syntax anywhere else in the system. 
All non-template outputs must use the system's custom variable format.

template.description: Handlebars template string. Use {{variable}} for simple substitution, {{#if condition}}...{{/if}} for conditionals, {{#each array}}...{{/each}} for loops.

input.description: Input data object containing variables to be used in the template

escapeHtml.description: Whether to escape HTML characters in the output (default: true). Set to false to render raw HTML.

output.description: The compiled output from the template

htmlEscaped.description: Whether HTML was escaped in the output

RenderTemplate.usageDescription:
This action is triggered by:
- **Submitting a new intake form**: Clicking "Submit & Generate PDF" at the bottom of the New Intake Form page
- **Generating a missing PDF**: Clicking "Generate PDF" on a form row in the Docs page that has no document yet
This lays out the intake form details into the document design before it is turned into the final PDF.

RunDaySchedule.usageDescription:
This action is triggered by:

- **Bookkeeper on the aging report**: Clicks "משוך עכשיו מפריוריטי" at the top of the aging report (גבייה → דוח גיול), whenever they want fresher numbers
  Pulls customers, open balances and open orders from Priority right away, then refreshes the collection tasks. A line on the screen says what was pulled, or what failed, and the report reloads. Until the Priority connection is set up, it shows a calm notice that the connection is not set up yet.
- **Every work-day morning, automatically**: Runs each round hour between 06:00 and 12:00, Sunday to Thursday
  Does the day's scheduled steps at the hours set in Settings → לוח זמנים, so the report is up to date before the team starts.

asOfDate.description: Default today in Asia/Jerusalem

bodyOverride.description: Template to use instead of the saved body, this run only

summary.description: Hebrew one-liner

RunMailAutomation.usageDescription:
This action is triggered by:

- **Previewing the monthly mail**: "הצגת התצוגה" in the automation card on the Inbox page (פניות → אוטומציות), after picking a sample customer
  Shows that customer's mail as it would be written — recipient, subject, body and the open-debts PDF — using the wording currently in the editor, even before it is saved, plus who would get the mail and who is left out and why. Nothing is written.
- **Checking a run before it happens**: "הרץ עכשיו" on the automation card
  Opens a window that first lists who would get the mail and who is left out, with the reason. Nothing is written yet.
- **Running it now**: "יצירת N טיוטות" in that window
  Creates the drafts in the outbox (one per customer), records the run in the history and shows a link to those drafts. Nothing is sent.

ScheduleAction.actionTypeDescription: Schedule one of this app's actions to run later: once at a date-time (runAt) or repeatedly on a cron. For timing chosen while the app runs, e.g. a cadence each user picks; for a date stored on a row use a date trigger instead. Returns a scheduleId to update or cancel it.

title.description: Short name for the schedule, e.g. "Remind Dana about invoice #42"

actionBlockId.description: The app action to run when the schedule fires: its name (as in the action artifact) or block id

input.description: Input the scheduled action runs with

runAt.description: ISO-8601 date-time with an offset (e.g. 2026-11-02T09:00:00+02:00) to run the action ONCE. Use either runAt or cron.

cron.description: Standard 5-field cron expression to run the action REPEATEDLY (e.g. "0 9 * * 1" = Mondays 09:00). At most once per hour. Use either runAt or cron.

timezone.description: IANA time zone the cron is read in (e.g. "America/New_York"). Defaults to UTC.

endAt.description: Optional ISO-8601 date-time after which a recurring schedule stops.

scheduleId.description: Id of the schedule; pass it to Update Schedule or Cancel Schedule

runAt.description: ISO time of a one-time run

nextRunAt.description: ISO time the action runs next; absent when paused or done

search_brain_documents.actionTypeDescription: Search this account's synced documents (PDF, Word, slides, images, text) and the text columns of tables an app made searchable (email bodies, ticket notes) by meaning, in any language, and get back the passages that answer it. A file hit has `kind: "file"`; a table row has `kind: "record"` with its `table` and `rowId` — read the whole row with query_table (`SELECT * FROM <table> WHERE <key column> = '<rowId>'`; describe_data_assets shows the columns, and a `rowId` with `|` is a composite key). Use it for what text says; use query_table for counts and numbers. Cite the `path` of the passages you use. It searches only the indexes this app made searchable; pass `scope: "account"` to search every app's indexes in the account — when the answer may be in data another app made searchable, or this app's search finds nothing.

query.title: Query
query.description: What to look for, as a plain question or topic in any language.

limit.title: Results
limit.description: How many passages to return (default 10, max 20).

assets.description: Only documents from any of these indexes, by asset name exactly: `files_google_drive_2` for a file folder, `raw_gmail_1_messages_details` or `modeled_…` for a table — not a folder, a connector slug or a `RAW.…` read name. In this app's own search (the default `scope`) one of its saved queries can also be named by its model name, as its index's `from` may name it; with `scope: "account"` only asset names match. At most 20; each hit's `source` shows its asset name. Leave it out to search every index.

tags.description: Only documents carrying every one of these tags. A file's tags are the folders it sits in, lower-cased: `Sales/Q3/deck.pdf` has `sales` and `q3`.

scope.description: Whose search indexes to search. `app` (the default): only those this app made searchable. `account`: every app's in the account — use it when the answer may be in data another app made searchable, or when the default finds nothing.

path.description: The document it came from — cite this. A file's path, or `rec:<asset>/<row id>` for a table row.

source.description: The asset the passage came from, by asset name (`files_…`, `raw_…`, `modeled_…` — a saved query's even when its index's `from` names it by model name) — a value `assets` matches.

rowId.description: A record's row key, several values joined by `|` for a composite key.

table.description: A record's table as query_table reads it — `RAW.GMAIL_1_MESSAGES`.

note.description: Context about a search that ran, such as nothing being indexed yet, or that a search of this app's indexes found nothing and `scope: "account"` might. Not an error.

error.description: Set when the search was refused or failed. Correct the request rather than retrying it unchanged.

limit.description: Max results (default 8)

asOfDate.description: Clock for tests: YYYY-MM-DD. Defaults to today in Asia/Jerusalem

senderKind.description: איש קשר רשום / סוכן סימנט / אחר

SendAgentMessage.actionTypeDescription: Send a message to an agent in the app by its block ID. The agent's configuration (provider, instructions, tools, memory, skills) is fetched automatically. When structuredOutputJsonSchema is set, the react or deep agent returns structured output matching that schema.

agentBlockId.description: The block ID of the agent to invoke.

prompt.description: The message/prompt to send to the agent.

threadId.description: Optional conversation id. Omit for a one-shot call. Pass the same value on a later call to this agent to continue the same conversation — the agent sees the earlier turns. Use a per-conversation value (an order id, a customer id): this id is the only thing separating one end user's conversation from another's, so a hardcoded value puts every user on one thread. Threads are per agent: the same value on another agent is a separate conversation.

threadTitle.description: Optional name for the conversation, shown in the agent's thread list instead of an AI-generated title. Applied only when the thread is created: a thread that already has a title keeps it, so this never renames an ongoing conversation. Use a value that identifies the conversation ("Order #1042", the customer's name). Leave empty to have the title generated from the first exchange.

rubric.description: Optional success criteria for THIS call — a newline-delimited checklist (one criterion per line). When set, a grader reviews the agent's response against these criteria and asks it to revise until they are all met. Per-call, like the prompt; omit to disable.

rubricMaxIterations.description: Max grade/revise iterations before the agent returns its best answer. Only relevant when rubric is set. Higher values raise cost/latency — the agent can run up to this many times for a single call.

promptSummary.description: for Ui purposes only, show the goal of this prompt to the user in 1 sentence. should be static without variables

chatId.description: Deprecated: use threadId. Still accepted — a chatId with no threadId is mapped to a fixed thread id derived from it.

shortTermMemory.description: Thread memory config. Only takes effect when threadId is set.

isPersistent.description: Persist the thread across restarts instead of keeping it in cache only.

streaming.description: Whether to stream the response. Ignored when structuredOutputJsonSchema is set.

allowAskUser.description: Let the agent pause the run to ask the user a question (human-in-the-loop). Requires a threadId with durable memory; without one the agent just answers in prose. When true, the action returns {status, answer, question, threadId} instead of the raw answer: status is "completed", "interrupted", or "queued" (the agent was busy on this thread; the message waits in its queue and the answer is not returned); on interrupt the answer is empty and the question is answered later from the agent's inbox.

structuredOutputJsonSchema.description:
An optional JSON schema for the final agent output. Structured Outputs JSON Schema ensures the model will always generate responses that adhere to your supplied JSON Schema.
        Some type-specific keywords are not supported. Notable keywords not supported include:
        For strings: minLength, maxLength, pattern, format
        For numbers: minimum, maximum, multipleOf
        For objects: patternProperties, unevaluatedProperties, propertyNames, minProperties, maxProperties
        For arrays: unevaluatedItems, contains, minContains, maxContains, minItems, maxItems, uniqueItems

chatComponentBlockId.description: Optional chat component (block id or name) to show the answer with in the app's agent chat. Its props schema becomes the output schema, so leave structuredOutputJsonSchema empty. Not an interrupt component.

files.description: Attachments as AgentCallFile objects: provide url and/or dataBlockId (dataBlockId is resolved to a download URL). Optional fileName and fileType help the model; comma-separated url values expand to multiple files.

url.description: Direct file URL (optional if dataBlockId is set).

fileType.description: MIME type or file type hint.

dataBlockId.description: File data block id; used to build a redirect URL when url is omitted.

SendAgentMessage.usageDescription:
This action is triggered by:

- **Preparing a delivery confirmation call**: Pressing "הכן תסריט שיחה" on the delivery coordination screen, after picking an order from the day's list
  The delivery agent reads the order, the site's known access constraints and the price cross-check, writes a call script in Hebrew, and opens it for approval before anyone phones the customer.

- **Handing a customer's price claim to the pricing agent**: Pressing "העבר לסוכן ההזמנות והתמחור" at the end of the played call, once the customer has said the agreed price was different
  The pricing agent checks the claim against the agreed price list, quantifies the gap in shekels, and prepares a correction for approval — the order is never sent back to the order desk.

- **Preparing a collection reminder**: Choosing WhatsApp or email and pressing "הכן טיוטת תזכורת" for a customer on the collections screen
  The collections agent drafts the reminder wording based on how old and how large the debt is, and the draft waits for approval before it is sent.

recipients.description: To recipients, multiple valid email addresses delimited by comma, newline or space

cc.description: CC recipients, multiple valid email addresses delimited by comma, newline or space

bcc.description: BCC recipients, multiple valid email addresses delimited by comma, newline or space

body.description: Body, should be a valid html

SendEmail.usageDescription:
This action is triggered by:
- **Reserving a seat**: Pressing "Confirm reservation" in the Reservation section at the bottom of the landing page, after filling in name, email, launch window, cabin class and number of seats
- **Reserving from the manifest or a cabin card**: Choosing a flight in the Launch manifest or pressing "Choose <cabin>" on a cabin card jumps to the same form, and the confirmation is sent when that form is submitted
As part of holding the seat, the guest is emailed their manifest code, mission name, departure time, launch site, cabin and seat count, so they have written proof of the booking straight away.

SentNotification.actionTypeDescription: Notify workspace members in Blocks — specific people, the whole workspace or this app's members: in their notifications on web and mobile (and this app's bell), and on their phones and computers

sendTo.title: Send to
sendTo.description: Who to notify: specific people (the recipients list), every admin and member of this workspace, or the members of this app. Empty = specific people.

recipients.title: Recipients
recipients.description: With "Specific people": workspace members to notify — emails and/or user ids, separated by commas, spaces or new lines (or a list from a workflow value). Anyone who is not an admin or member of this workspace is skipped and reported back as not found.

appRoles.title: App roles
appRoles.description: With "All app members": only app members with any of these roles (role names, separated by commas or new lines, at most 20). Empty = every app member. A role this app doesn't have is reported back as not found.

appPermission.title: App access
appPermission.description: With "All app members": everyone in the app, only its builders (who can edit it), or only its users (who can use it).

excludeTrigger.title: Skip the person who triggered it
excludeTrigger.description: Don't notify the person whose action ran this workflow (for example, whoever saved the record), even if they are a recipient. A scheduled workflow counts as run by whoever set up the schedule.

imageUrl.title: Image
imageUrl.description: An image uploaded to Blocks, shown with the notification: an image field from your data, or an app or profile image. Images from your data show only inside Blocks; app and profile images also show on desktop and Android alerts, except in HIPAA workspaces.

openTarget.title: Opens
openTarget.description: What opening the notification goes to: a page of this app (Open page), this app's builder, or a Blocks page (Open page, e.g. /settings).

path.title: Open page
path.description: The page opening the notification goes to. Starts with a single /, e.g. /orders/123 (at most 512 characters). Required when it opens a Blocks page.

priority.title: Priority
priority.description: Urgent notifications are marked in the notifications list and break through Focus and quiet modes on phones where the phone allows it.

sendPush.title: Also notify their phones
sendPush.description: Also send a phone notification showing the title and message. HIPAA workspaces get generic text instead.

dedupeKey.title: Notify once per
dedupeKey.description: Optional. A value such as the order's id: each person gets one notification per value, however many times a workflow in this app runs with it (for 90 days). Empty = every run notifies.

replyOptions.title: Quick answers
replyOptions.description: Optional. Up to 4 answers people can tap right from the notification (at most 40 characters each): one per line, or separated by commas on one line, or a list from a workflow value (passed as the list itself, an answer with a comma in it stays one answer). The Title or Message asks the question. Each answer runs the app's "When a notification is answered" workflows with the answer's text.

allowTextReply.title: Allow typed reply
allowTextReply.description: Let people type an answer of their own right from the notification (with or without quick answers). It runs the app's "When a notification is answered" workflows with what they typed.

replyPlaceholder.title: Reply placeholder
replyPlaceholder.description: Optional. The hint in the typed reply's field, e.g. "Add a note for the customer" (at most 60 characters). Empty = "Reply…".

replyKey.title: Reply key
replyKey.description: Optional. A name for what this notification asks, e.g. "order-approval": a "When a notification is answered" trigger with the same Reply key runs only for answers to it. Uses letters, numbers, spaces and . _ : - (at most 128 characters); case doesn't matter and spaces count as -.

replyContext.title: Reply context
replyContext.description: Optional. A value handed back with the answer, so the workflow it runs knows what was answered — the id of the record it asks about, e.g. the order id (at most 1000 characters).

replaceKey.title: Replace earlier notification with the same key
replaceKey.description: Optional. A value such as the order's id: a newer notification from this app with the same value replaces the earlier one's alert on phones and computers instead of stacking up. Both stay in the notifications list.

notifyAllMembers.title: Notify all workspace members
notifyAllMembers.description: Replaced by "Send to". Still honored when "Send to" is empty.

notFound.title: Not found
notFound.description: Recipients (emails or user ids) that are not members of this workspace, and app roles this app doesn't have

replyRequested.title: Reply requested
replyRequested.description: Whether people can answer it (it has quick answers or allows a typed reply)

replyKey.title: Reply key
replyKey.description: The Reply key a "When a notification is answered" trigger matches, as it was saved (lowercase, spaces as -); null when there is none

by.description: Display name of the person changing the state

SetEmailHandling.usageDescription:
This action is triggered by:

- **Closing a mail**: "סימון טופל" at the top of the mail panel on the Inbox page (פניות → דואר נכנס), opened by clicking a mail
  Marks the mail as handled (shown in green) with who closed it and when; its 24-hour ring stops.
- **Putting a mail on hold**: "סימון ממתין" in the same panel, then writing who we wait for (e.g. "ממתין ללקוח") and confirming
  Marks the mail as waiting, with for whom and since when.
- **Reopening a mail**: "החזרה ל״לא טופל״" in the same panel
  Puts the mail back in the open list.
- **Handling several mails at once**: tick mails in the inbox list, then the same three buttons in the bar above the list
  Changes the handling state of all the ticked mails together.

SyncFromBrain.usageDescription:
This action is triggered by:

- **Admin on the Settings import page**: clicks "סנכרן עכשיו" in the "סנכרון מפריוריטי (Brain)" section

- **Automatically**: twice a day, at 06:30 and 18:30

  When reading invoices runs out of time, the page automatically continues from where it stopped (showing "ממשיך קריאה… חלק N"), up to 5 more times.

SyncPriorityBankLines.usageDescription:
This action is triggered by:

- **Pulling today's bank lines**: Clicking "משוך עכשיו מפריוריטי" at the top of the "תקבולים" screen, when the bank lines source in the settings is "שורות פריוריטי"
  Brings in today's bank statement lines from Priority, adds only lines that are not there yet, and identifies the customer of each new transfer or bank credit with a confidence score. The button waits until it finishes and then shows one line with what came in and what the identification found. Cheque clearings and other lines are only listed. There is no automatic schedule yet, so this button is the only way the pull runs. Until the Priority connection is set up, the button shows a calm notice that the connection is not set up yet and nothing is pulled.

  Reads customer contacts and receipt payment lines from Priority into the app (or only checks what would change when "check only" is on). If a read stops partway, the screen continues it automatically up to 5 times.
- **Daily schedule**: Runs automatically every day at 07:00.

TypeSafeJevCall.actionTypeDescription: Makes fast, typed decisions: it evaluates a state against named questions and returns a calibrated answer per question instead of generated text. Question types: `noul` (yes/no, returns the probability of yes), `choice` (picks one option from up to 255, returns the option, a probability per option and a confidence) and `score` (rates against 2-10 ordered levels, returns a weighted level index, a probability per level and a confidence). Use it for classification, routing, triage, scoring, guardrails and verification. Ask many atomic questions in one call and combine them in code; gate actions on `confidence`. Do NOT use it for text generation, arithmetic, counting or date comparison: extract the parts with questions and compute in code. Models: `jev-latest` (TypeSafe Jev) answers in well under a second with calibrated probabilities and is the default; `openai-luna` (OpenAI Luna) answers the same questions in one structured call, with probabilities that are its own estimates rather than calibrated, so prefer it when a decision needs broader world knowledge or reasoning. Text-only state, 32k tokens on Jev.

modelName.description: Decision model. `jev-latest` (TypeSafe Jev) follows TypeSafe's stable release and is the default; any `jev-*` id is accepted, and a versioned one (e.g. `jev-1.13.0`) pins the model so tuned confidence thresholds stay valid. `openai-luna` (OpenAI Luna) runs the decision as one structured call on the newest Luna model.

state.description: The content to evaluate: a string, or a JSON object/array (chat logs, records, application state). Send only what the questions need. Questions can point at nested fields by name in backticks, e.g. `ticket.body`. Variables syntax: {{input.VariableName}}.

questions.description: Map of question id -> question. Ids are yours to choose, are never sent to the model, and key the answers in the output.

instructions.description: The yes/no question, or an object holding the question in one field and the data it refers to in others.

criteria.description: Optional descriptions of what yes and no mean.
Map of option -> rubric description (string, object, array, or null). 2-255 options; add an `other`/`none` option when nothing may fit.

model.description: The model id that answered: Jev's versioned id, or the OpenAI snapshot (log it next to thresholds)

answers.description: One typed answer per question, keyed by question id

UnzipFile.actionTypeDescription: Extract a zip archive into individual file blocks. Downloads the zip from a protected internal URL (ending with /redirect) or a public/pre-signed URL, extracts each entry (directories and macOS __MACOSX metadata are skipped, nested paths are flattened to file names), stores each as an internal file block, and returns a protected internal URL per file. Pass "entries" to extract only specific files (matched by full path or file name); omit it to extract everything. Guards against oversized archives (500MB compressed / 1GB uncompressed / 1000 files).

fileUrl.description: URL of the zip file to extract. Supports a protected internal URL (ending with /redirect) or a public/pre-signed URL.

entries.description: Optional allowlist of entries to extract. Each value matches an entry by its full path inside the zip (e.g. "docs/report.pdf") or by its file name (e.g. "report.pdf"). When omitted or empty, every file is extracted.

files.description: The files extracted from the zip archive.

protectedUrl.description: The protected internal URL (ending with /redirect) for the extracted file.

blockId.description: The block id of the extracted file.

fileName.description: The name of the extracted file.

fileSize.description: The size of the extracted file in bytes.

contentType.description: The MIME type of the extracted file (inferred from extension).

fileCount.description: The number of files extracted from the zip archive.

UpdateCustomerNote.usageDescription:
This action is triggered by:

- **Editing a note**: In the small notes window (opened from the aging report, a customer card's "חודשים פתוחים" table or a grouped task's row), the user clicks the pencil on an active note, changes its date, text, reminder or amount, and clicks "שמירת שינויים"

paymentState.title: paymentState
paymentState.description: App layer (never written by the Priority sync): payment we have seen. נראה תשלום = an approved receipt match pays this invoice and the receipt is not yet in Priority; נקלט ב-Priority = the match was marked done in Priority. Empty = no payment seen by the app. Recomputed by the shared invoice-layer code

paidSeenAmount.title: paidSeenAmount
paidSeenAmount.description: App layer: ILS of this invoice paid by approved receipt matches (sum of their allocations)

paidSeenAt.title: paidSeenAt

paidPriorityDoneAt.title: paidPriorityDoneAt

layerUpdatedAt.title: layerUpdatedAt
layerUpdatedAt.description: App layer: when the payment and note fields above were last recomputed. ISO 8601 datetime string, format: YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS, e.g. 2025-09-30T18:45:00Z, 2025-09-30T18:45:00+05:30

paymentStatus.title: paymentStatus
paymentStatus.description: App layer (never written by the Priority sync): payment status from our receipt allocations. פתוחה = nothing allocated; שולמה חלקית = allocated less than Priority's open amount; שולמה = fully allocated. Priority's own status stays in status.

remainingAmount.title: remainingAmount
remainingAmount.description: App layer: what is still open after our receipt allocations = openAmount − paidSeenAmount while Priority has not reflected them, else openAmount. The aging report and the customer card show this

receiptKeys.title: receiptKeys
receiptKeys.description: App layer: comma-separated Receipts.receiptKey of the receipts allocated to this invoice

VoiceCall.actionTypeDescription: Make a voice call using Vapi AI

instructions.title: Assistant instructions
instructions.description: Define voice agent's personality, role, and how they should behave on the call

firstMessage.description: First message the assistant will say when the call is answered

language.title: Call language
language.description: Set this to match the language the user asked for. If the request, the instructions, or the firstMessage are written in a given language (e.g. Hebrew → "he", Spanish → "es", French → "fr"), you MUST set this field to that language code — do not leave it on the default "en" just because the language setting wasn't mentioned explicitly. Spoken language of the call. This single field automatically configures the best transcriber (speech-to-text), voice model (text-to-speech) and assistant conversation language — no other language setup is needed or possible. "en" (default) keeps the standard English setup: Deepgram transcription with the selected ElevenLabs voice. Hebrew uses Deepgram transcription and the selected native Hebrew Cartesia voice (see voiceId for the Hebrew voice catalog). Every other language pins a multilingual ElevenLabs transcriber to that exact language (never auto-detected); it then uses the selected ElevenLabs voice where supported, or a native Azure neural voice for languages ElevenLabs cannot speak (ca, et, lt, lv, th). For Hebrew the stability/similarityBoost/speed voice settings are ignored; for Azure-voiced languages the selected voiceId and the stability/similarityBoost settings are ignored. The assistant is always instructed to converse in the selected language. Always write instructions, firstMessage and endCallMessage in the selected language. Unsupported codes fall back to "en".

VoiceCall.usageDescription:
This action is triggered by:
- **Placing a collections call from a customer card**: Pressing "שיחת סוכן" in the phone section of the customer detail card, then pressing "אישור והתקשרות" in the call dialog
- **Placing a quick call from the collections desk**: Pressing the phone icon on a customer row in the collections desk table, then pressing "אישור והתקשרות" in the call dialog
After the user approves, the collections agent phones the tenant, speaks Hebrew with the full debt context, and once the call ends the app shows the summary, transcript and recording and proposes an outcome for the user to confirm.

WriteBriefing.usageDescription:
This action is not triggered from any screen.

- **The morning run**: Runs automatically every Sunday–Thursday morning as part of the morning run
  Writes today's briefing for every bookkeeper and for the whole team from the current data: what came in from the bank, what was identified, what waits for approval, promises seen, bounced cheques and open tasks. The history of the briefings is shown on the "תדריכי הבוקר" page, opened with "כל תדריכי הבוקר" on the "היום" screen.
